meta_title: ItriPay — Your phone is the terminal
meta_description: ItriPay is a SoftPOS payment solution: your phone becomes the payment terminal. A digital credit carnet, sales reports and four languages, for 49 MAD a month. Pre-launch: join the waitlist.
star_label: The ItriPay star: four points, four values
hero_sub: ItriPay is a SoftPOS payment solution: your phone becomes the payment terminal. It helps merchants and service providers accept digital payments more easily.
v1_line: Merchant and customer, one tap apart.
v2_line: Enter the amount. Hand over the phone. Done.
v3_line: The customer sees the amount before they tap.
problem_title: Your customer has a card. You only take cash.
problem_sub: So the sale walks away. A card machine means a monthly fee and paperwork with the bank. And the paper credit book gets lost, along with the debts in it.
problem_1_body: A payment terminal is a second device to rent, charge and keep track of.
problem_2_body: Who owes what lives in a notebook that can be lost, and nobody adds up the total.
problem_3_body: At closing time, the day’s sales are a guess.
how_1_body: Type the price on the keypad, the way you would on a calculator.
how_2_body: The customer sees the amount and taps a card or phone on yours.
how_3_body: A receipt, printed or shared on WhatsApp. The sale is already in your records.
features_title: Everything a shop needs. Nothing it doesn’t.
feat_1_body: The phone the merchant already owns takes the payment.
feat_2_body: Daily, monthly and yearly reports. Export to PDF or Excel.
feat_3_body: Your logo and shop name, printed or shared on WhatsApp.
feat_4_body: Add employees and choose what each one may do.
feat_5_body: Darija, Tamazight, French and English, chosen on the first screen.
credit_body: Every neighbourhood shop keeps a notebook of who owes what. ItriPay keeps it for you: each customer, each debt, each payment against it, and a total that is always current.
credit_p1: One list, every balance, never out of date.
credit_p2: Register a payment against a debt in two taps.
credit_p3: SMS reminders, sent when you decide, not by themselves.
who_title: Made for anyone who sells and wants to get paid.
nodevice_sub: The phone you own is the terminal.
pricing_rule: Free if you don’t reach 500 MAD revenue in 30 days.
pricing_how: Activate for free, use everything. If your revenue exceeds 500 MAD in 30 days, 49 MAD is deducted automatically.
inc_2: Sales and analytics: daily, monthly and yearly reports
inc_6: Custom receipt with your logo and shop name
partners_title: We are looking for a licensed payment partner.
partners_body: ItriPay is the merchant’s app: the terminal on the phone, the carnet, the reports. To move money it needs a licensed payment institution or acquiring bank behind it. We are not licensed ourselves, and we do not claim to be.
partners_p1: A working Android app in four languages
partners_p2: Built around the neighbourhood shop, not adapted to it
partners_p3: Open to payment institutions, acquirers and banks in Morocco
name_body: ⵉⵜⵔⵉ, itri, is the Tamazight word for star. Long before maps, traders crossed this country by the stars. We took the name for the same reason: a fixed point a merchant can count on.
faq_1_q: Do I need a card reader or any extra device?
faq_1_a: No. ItriPay runs on an Android phone with NFC. There is nothing else to buy or rent.
faq_2_a: 49 MAD a month, everything included. It is free in any 30 days where your revenue stays under 500 MAD.
faq_3_q: Can I take payments with it today?
faq_3_a: Not yet. ItriPay is pre-launch and we are looking for a licensed payment partner. Join the waitlist and we will write to you when it opens.
faq_4_q: Is ItriPay a bank or a payment institution?
faq_4_a: No. ItriPay is software. Payments will be processed by a licensed partner.
faq_5_q: Which languages does the app speak?
faq_6_a: The notebook of who owes what, kept on the phone: each customer, each debt, each payment, and a total that is always current.
